what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Poland in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 120 Polish asylum seekers in the United States, 29.5% of all asylum seekers from Poland.
Refugees from Poland, a separate group, live mostly in Germany, Canada, Denmark and Sweden.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Poland, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2001, 2005 and 2016 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 112 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 921, at the end of 2021, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
